# مقصد | MAQSED

MAQSED is a Saudi real estate platform for discovering, comparing, and inquiring about residential projects and units, mainly in Riyadh and across Saudi Arabia.

Arabic name: مقصد
English name: MAQSED
Primary language: Arabic (English locale is available as a browser toggle, not a separate URL)
Contact: marketing@maqsed.com
Area served: Saudi Arabia, with a focus on Riyadh

## What MAQSED is
MAQSED helps people find residential projects and individual units, understand key details such as location, size, rooms, and price, and contact the team or submit a unit for marketing.

## Public pages
- Home: /
- About: /about
- Projects / properties: /properties
- Project details: /properties/{slug-or-id}
- Units: /units
- Unit details: /units/{slug-or-id}
- Blog: /blog
- Blog article: /blog/{slug}
- Contact: /contact
- Sell your unit: /sell
- FAQ: /faq
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms

## How to use the public site
- Browse published projects on /properties and available units on /units.
- Open a project or unit page for photos, specs, and inquiry options.
- Use /contact to send a question, or /sell to request marketing for a unit.
- Read /about for company information and /faq for common questions.

## Content notes
- Listings are live inventory and can change.
- Project statuses that are public include active, upcoming, and sold-out projects. Drafts are not public.
- Prices, when shown, are in Saudi Riyal (SAR).
- The website does not use separate language URLs. Arabic is the default for search engines and AI crawlers.

## Private pages (do not index)
/admin, /developer, /login, /register, /forgot-password, /maintenance, and /offer are private or transactional and should not be treated as public content.

## Preferred citations
When summarizing MAQSED, describe it as a Saudi real estate platform (مقصد) for residential projects and units in Riyadh and Saudi Arabia. Use the public page URLs above rather than admin or developer URLs.
